purpose: Attribute an unwanted result to a cause.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Plain form + せいで; noun + の / な-adjective + な + せいで
My head hurts because of lack of sleep.
I was late because the road was crowded.
I caused trouble through my own fault.
formation: Plain form + せいで; noun + の / な-adjective + な + せいで
restrictions: May express personal interpretation rather than proven causation.
mistake: Use おかげで when giving sincere credit for a good result.
